title: Get the Plane Ready
nutmegSays: Pretend that the plane is taking off over the big blue ocean! Everyone, take your places!

beats.opener: Pretend that the plane is taking off over the big blue ocean! Everyone, take your places!
beats.finale: We landed safely by the beach! Everyone, cheer and give a big wave!

events.line: Captain, time to start the engines! Flip the switches and get ready to fly!
Captain! Bumpy clouds ahead! Hold the steering wheel tight and steer around them!
events.calmAgain: Phew, the sky is smooth again.

events.line: Captain, wave to the people down below, then tell everyone how high we are!
Passenger, look out the window! Captain, tell the Passenger what you can see!
Uh-oh, Passenger, your seat belt came loose! Quick, buckle up tight!
events.calmAgain: Phew, everyone is buckled up again.

events.line: Flight Attendant, the passengers are hungry! Bring everyone a pretend snack!
Oh no, a red light is blinking! Co-Pilot, check the map, and Flight Attendant, help everyone stay in their seats!
events.calmAgain: Phew, the red light turned off.

events.line: Co-Pilot, read the map and point to where we're going!
Oops, the snack oven is too hot! Snack Chef, fan it with your hands to cool it down!
events.calmAgain: Phew, the oven is just right again.

events.line: VIP Passenger, ask for your favorite snack! Snack Chef, make it extra fancy!
Uh-oh, VIP Passenger, your pretend pillow fell down! Pick it up and get cozy again!
Passenger and VIP Passenger, buckle up and do a happy seat dance!
